dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge displays a concave spline curvature from the apex to the posterior base, creating a distinctly falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as rounded with a medium pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour presents an approximate 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.4:1 ratio of the maximum pixel base width to the maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-profile convexity with a large arc radius transitioning from the blowhole region to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Visible beak is short and robust; pixel length from the inflection point is approximately equal to the thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: An obtuse interior angle is visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon curvature transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white concentric circular pattern, resembling a fingerprint or digital watermark, is located on the upper posterior portion of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlights causing pixel saturation along the dorsal-lateral ridge; presence of a dark, longitudinal lateral band.
